disambiguation: Not a template insertion tool like core Templates; it packages templates with note context into AI prompts.
extras: Freemium: Core (template discovery, prompt building, clipboard copy) is free; Pro adds in-Obsidian generation with streamed output and model selection.
intentEvidence: Smart Templates does not ask you to replace the template system you already like.
motivation: Every AI prompt is a mini project: gather the right notes, explain the task, paste the structure, and remind the model how to answer.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to combine existing note structures with gathered context into AI prompts, so users re-assemble the same prompt scaffolding by hand every time.
